title: Phase 4 Mandatory Field Extraction Evaluation Report

audit_details.reason:
Dataset Audit Finding: 1. SROIE dataset contains receipt key-values ('company', 'date', 'address', 'total'), not the 9 mandatory Legal Metrology packaged commodity fields.
2. Product Description English/Hindi OCR dataset contains full text line transcripts, not field-level entity bounding boxes or 9 field annotations.
3. Open Food Facts India contains product-level metadata but lacks OCR region-level field annotations for model evaluation.
As per Step 13 & Step 14 strict rules: Field-level ground truth is NOT_AVAILABLE. Fabrication of ground truth annotations or fake metrics is strictly prohibited.
